COND-CLEAR.title: Unregulated Sunshine
COND-CLEAR.continuing: The clear weather continues. The sun has not returned the communications team’s calls.
COND-CLEAR.onset: Clear skies. The radio credits Trump’s energy agenda. The sun declines the cabinet appointment.
COND-CLEAR.recovery: The clear spell ends. Apparently the sun serves at its own pleasure.

COND-COLD.title: A Private Climate
COND-COLD.continuing: The cold continues. Energy security still appears to be indoors.
COND-COLD.onset: Cold grips the route. The fossil-fuel lobby calls its dinner an energy-security event. You’d like to attend the room-temperature portion.
COND-COLD.recovery: The cold eases. Your fingers regain the ability to disagree with a press release.

COND-COLDEXPOSURE.title: The Private Warmth Sector
COND-COLDEXPOSURE.continuing: The cold remains harmful. Seek protection; donor enthusiasm has no measurable heat output.
COND-COLDEXPOSURE.onset: Cold exposure is now causing harm. The political donor’s promise of opportunity offers several square feet of cardboard. You investigate its insulation policy.
COND-COLDEXPOSURE.recovery: Exposure is relieved. Your hands regain the ability to put the leaflet down.

COND-HEAT.title: The Freedom to Sweat
COND-HEAT.continuing: The heat persists. The protest has spread to every seat.
COND-HEAT.onset: A heat wave settles over the route. Politicians call mandatory water breaks overreach. Your sweat appears to be a grassroots protest.
COND-HEAT.recovery: The heat eases. The seats begin negotiating a return to normal relations.

COND-HEATEXPOSURE.title: The Cost of Local Control
COND-HEATEXPOSURE.continuing: Heat is still causing harm. Get protection and attend to the crew; the slogan has no cooling setting.
COND-HEATEXPOSURE.onset: Prolonged heat is now harming the crew. Opponents of mandatory heat breaks promised freedom. Your body has mistaken it for permission to shut down.
COND-HEATEXPOSURE.recovery: Heat exposure is relieved. Your body accepts the change without a constitutional challenge.

COND-HUNGER.title: Trickle-Down Lunch
COND-HUNGER.continuing: Hunger continues. You turn the bowl around to improve reception.
COND-HUNGER.onset: Food is running short. Congress has cut projected food-aid spending. Someone holds an empty bowl under the radio, just in case the savings trickle down.
COND-HUNGER.recovery: Food relieves the hunger. It arrives through an actual person, a supply the radio had overlooked.

COND-ILLNESS.title: An Unfunded Body
COND-ILLNESS.continuing: The illness continues. Your body remains inconveniently outside the budget’s success metrics.
COND-ILLNESS.onset: Illness hits the journey. Congress calls health-budget cuts a saving. Your body would like to see the return address for whatever it caught.
COND-ILLNESS.recovery: The illness clears. Recovery has happened despite the running commentary.

COND-SMOKE.title: Now With More Freedom
COND-SMOKE.continuing: The smoke persists. Freedom has developed a taste you can’t get out of your mouth.
COND-SMOKE.onset: Smoke hangs over the road. The radio celebrates rolling back environmental rules. You close the windows on the celebration.
COND-SMOKE.recovery: The smoke clears. Breathing briefly returns to being a background activity.

COND-STORM.title: The Map Is Dry
COND-STORM.continuing: Rain continues. The forecast map is the only dry territory you control.
COND-STORM.onset: A storm lashes the van. You consider the Sharpiegate approach, but there isn’t enough marker to cross out the sky.
COND-STORM.recovery: The storm passes. The sky has corrected itself without a press conference.

CROSS-01.title: American Enough
CROSS-01.setup: At the checkpoint, an officer demands an American-made van. You open the hood. He starts an international incident with the alternator.

outcomes.passage: He waves you through. The alternator is admitted on a temporary work visa.
outcomes.diversion: You take the detour. The alternator remains suspiciously good at its job.
outcomes.permit_receipt: Your permit clears the van. The alternator is included as a dependent. One Receipt is used.
outcomes.permit_tag: Your permit clears the van. The alternator is included as a dependent. Your permit tag remains available.
outcomes.bribe_success: The payment clears the barrier. Your money passes the nationality test.
outcomes.bribe_failure: He takes the payment and keeps the barrier down. Apparently tariffs work here too.
outcomes.refused_passage: The officer refuses passage. You take the detour, with the alleged foreign threat still charging the battery.

CROSS-02C.title: The Department of Barrier
CROSS-02C.setup: The crossing office has copied Trump’s “Department of War” makeover. The new nameplate is enormous. Behind it, two workers are holding up the barrier by hand.

outcomes.passage: You cross while the workers hold the barrier. The nameplate offers strong moral support.
outcomes.diversion: You take the detour. The new department has secured a decisive victory over traffic.
outcomes.permit_receipt: The permit clears you. A worker lifts the barrier with his actual defense budget: both arms. One Receipt is used.
outcomes.permit_tag: The permit clears you. A worker lifts the barrier with his actual defense budget: both arms. Your permit tag remains available.
outcomes.bribe_success: The payment gets the barrier raised. The department has discovered arms funding.
outcomes.bribe_failure: The payment disappears into the office. The workers still have only the original two arms each.
outcomes.terminal_failure: You cannot complete this crossing. The expedition ends beneath a nameplate large enough to hide the problem.

CROSS-02D.title: The Purity Lane
CROSS-02D.setup: The checkpoint has borrowed Trump’s patriotic-education rules. The officer asks whether you love America. You say yes. He demands proof that you have never wanted anything fixed.

outcomes.passage: You pass. Loving the country has been temporarily separated from liking the queue.
outcomes.diversion: You detour. The officer records your route choice as a curriculum problem.
outcomes.permit_receipt: Your permit clears you. Apparently paperwork loves America enough for everybody. One Receipt is used.
outcomes.permit_tag: Your permit clears you. Apparently paperwork loves America enough for everybody. Your permit tag remains available.
outcomes.bribe_success: The payment clears the lane. Patriotism has a suggested donation.
outcomes.bribe_failure: He takes the payment and refuses passage. Your donation was insufficiently sincere.
outcomes.terminal_failure: You cannot complete the crossing. The expedition ends with the country still insisting it has no problems.

CROSS-03.title: Free Speech Has a Cover Charge
CROSS-03.setup: At the final crossing, the official calls campaign spending “speech.” He looks at your van full of actual speakers. “We meant the folding kind.”

outcomes.passage: You cross. Your voices have briefly cleared a market that prefers banknotes.
outcomes.diversion: You take the diversion. Apparently freedom of speech includes a longer walk to the microphone.
outcomes.permit_receipt: Your permit clears you. For once, paper gets heard without having a face printed on it. One Receipt is used.
outcomes.permit_tag: Your permit clears you. For once, paper gets heard without having a face printed on it. Your permit tag remains available.
outcomes.bribe_success: The payment opens the barrier. Your money has delivered a concise and persuasive address.
outcomes.bribe_failure: The money is taken; passage is refused. Your speech has been entered into somebody’s wallet.
outcomes.terminal_failure: The crossing ends your expedition. The official describes the silence as a healthy marketplace of ideas.

END-COLD.title: The Insulated Donor
END-COLD.headline: The Insulated Donor
END-COLD.epilogue: Cold exposure ends the journey. The political fundraiser’s dinner is kept warm under little silver lids. Apparently even a potato can obtain better representation.

END-COLLAPSE-BREAKDOWN.title: The Invoice Won
END-COLLAPSE-BREAKDOWN.headline: The Invoice Won
END-COLLAPSE-BREAKDOWN.epilogue: The unresolved breakdown ends the expedition. Trump said the tariffs would be paid overseas. The repair quote has spent the whole discussion looking directly at you.

END-COLLAPSE-CROSSING.title: Money Clears Customs
END-COLLAPSE-CROSSING.headline: Money Clears Customs
END-COLLAPSE-CROSSING.epilogue: The crossing ends the expedition. In American politics, enormous sums move freely as independent speech. Your actual people have encountered a less accommodating barrier.

END-COLLAPSE-DISEASE.title: Illness Has No Upload Button
END-COLLAPSE-DISEASE.headline: Illness Has No Upload Button
END-COLLAPSE-DISEASE.epilogue: Illness ends the expedition. Congress wants work documented before more people can keep benefits. Your body has been doing nothing but fight. It has neglected to create a login.

END-COLLAPSE-HUNGER.title: Trickle-Down, Mouth Open
END-COLLAPSE-HUNGER.headline: Trickle-Down, Mouth Open
END-COLLAPSE-HUNGER.epilogue: Hunger ends the expedition. Congress cut projected food-aid spending and called it savings. You cannot eat the forecast, although it now contains a very impressive number.

END-COLLAPSE-PANIC.title: Nothing to See, Too Much to Hear
END-COLLAPSE-PANIC.headline: Nothing to See, Too Much to Hear
END-COLLAPSE-PANIC.epilogue: Panic ends the expedition. Officials who misplaced bombing plans will continue explaining that everyone else is overreacting. You switch off the briefing; it is the first thing to stop escalating.

END-COLLAPSE-VEHICLE.title: The Vehicle Has Rebranded
END-COLLAPSE-VEHICLE.headline: The Vehicle Has Rebranded
END-COLLAPSE-VEHICLE.epilogue: Vehicle condition ends the expedition. Trump gave defense a fiercer name. You could try the same with the van, but “unstoppable” would now be blocking traffic.

END-COLLAPSE-WEATHER.title: Weather, Unedited
END-COLLAPSE-WEATHER.headline: Weather, Unedited
END-COLLAPSE-WEATHER.epilogue: Weather ends the expedition. Sharpiegate demonstrated how to change a forecast with a pen. Nobody demonstrated how to drive across the correction.

END-DESTROYED.title: America First, Van Last
END-DESTROYED.headline: America First, Van Last
END-DESTROYED.epilogue: The van is destroyed. The journey ends with American travelers unable to travel. The tariff pitch promised to protect domestic industry; your contribution now appears to be scrap.

END-FALLBACK.title: An Unclassified Ending
END-FALLBACK.headline: An Unclassified Ending
END-FALLBACK.epilogue: This account does not say how the journey ended. After the bombing-plan group chat, check the recipient list. The government may have sent the conclusion to a man who sells patio furniture.

END-HEAT.title: Local Control of the Thermostat
END-HEAT.headline: Local Control of the Thermostat
END-HEAT.epilogue: Heat exposure ends the expedition. Politicians who oppose mandatory worker heat breaks make their case indoors. The thermostat has been allowed to regulate without a public hearing.

END-INCOMPLETE.title: The Committee Is Still Somewhere Ahead
END-INCOMPLETE.headline: The Committee Is Still Somewhere Ahead
END-INCOMPLETE.epilogue: This journey is unfinished. In Washington, the donor dinner is still on the calendar. The chicken has secured an appointment; your case is still on the road.

END-SANITY.title: The Brain Declines the Briefing
END-SANITY.headline: The Brain Declines the Briefing
END-SANITY.epilogue: You cannot keep going; your sanity is exhausted. Officials who put bombing plans in a group chat will continue lecturing everyone about judgment. Yours has at least recognized an emergency.

END-VICTORY.title: The Quarter PAC
END-VICTORY.headline: The Quarter PAC
END-VICTORY.epilogue: You win the final vote. A lobbyist asks which super PAC backed you. You show the laundry change. He looks underneath it for the billionaire.

END-VOTEFAIL.title: The Wrong Kind of Speech
END-VOTEFAIL.headline: The Wrong Kind of Speech
END-VOTEFAIL.epilogue: The final vote goes against you. You brought evidence, testimony and an actual journey. The donor envelope brought none of these and gets invited to dinner.

HEARING-C.title: The Two-Minute Citizens
HEARING-C.setup: At the D.C. hearing, the chair gives you two minutes. His political donors get three hours over dinner. Apparently chicken needs more representation.
HEARING-C.before_vote: You endured the procedure. One vote now decides the case. For a moment, the menu goes face down.
HEARING-C.exhausted: You cannot endure the remaining procedure. Your hearing ends before the vote; the dinner reservation survives.

transitions.r0: The first procedural round drains your stamina. The chair explains how valuable everyone’s time is, at length.
transitions.r1: Another round of procedure. The donor-dinner menu arrives before anyone has addressed your case.
transitions.r2: The last procedural round. The chair asks for brevity, then reads the dessert options.

HEARING-D.title: The Public Input Slot
HEARING-D.setup: At the D.C. hearing, a political donor’s envelope gets its own chair. You stand at the public microphone. Unlimited independent spending has developed excellent posture.
HEARING-D.before_vote: You endured the rounds. One vote decides the case. The envelope is allowed to observe without folding its arms.
HEARING-D.exhausted: You cannot endure the remaining rounds. Your hearing ends before a vote; the envelope is invited to stay.

transitions.r0: The first procedural round drains stamina. The chair thanks the envelope for making time.
transitions.r1: The next round concerns access. A clerk adjusts the envelope’s microphone.
transitions.r2: The final procedural round. The envelope has said nothing and is still considered the room’s leading contributor.

OPEN-JOURNALIST.title: Seattle: Added to the Chat
OPEN-JOURNALIST.setup: You leave Seattle with five companions and a reporter’s notebook. Trump’s team sent bombing plans to a journalist by accident. You’re hoping your government answers questions nearly as easily.
OPEN-JOURNALIST.outcome: The van pulls out. You check the route twice, placing it ahead of the national-security team.

OPEN-LOBBYIST.title: Los Angeles: Access, Economy Class
OPEN-LOBBYIST.setup: You know how Washington sells access. Unfortunately, your five companions know how much gas costs. You leave Los Angeles for D.C. with lobbying experience and a donor network consisting of the glove box.
OPEN-LOBBYIST.outcome: The van heads east. Loose change speaks, mostly when you hit a pothole.

OPEN-ORGANIZER.title: Portland: The Public Workforce
OPEN-ORGANIZER.setup: DOGE keeps firing public workers and calling it efficiency. You organize five companions for a trip from Portland to D.C. Fitting everyone’s luggage into one van is your first suspiciously public service.
OPEN-ORGANIZER.outcome: You set out. Nobody has been fired for pointing out that the cooler needs room.

OPEN-SATIRIST.title: San Diego: The Ocean Kept Its Job
OPEN-SATIRIST.setup: Trump renamed the Gulf. You’re a satirist leaving San Diego with five companions to ask D.C. whether changing the name of broke also helps. The van votes for “temporarily presidential.”
OPEN-SATIRIST.outcome: You set out. The newly prestigious budget still requires cheap gas.

OPEN-STAFFER.title: Sacramento: The Brand Survives
OPEN-STAFFER.setup: Trump added “Department of War” to the government’s branding. You’re a staffer leaving Sacramento with five companions to ask D.C. for actual help. You name the van “Reliable.” Nothing mechanical happens.
OPEN-STAFFER.outcome: You set out. The new nameplate weighs less than a working spare and accomplishes considerably less.

OPEN-WHISTLEBLOWER.title: San Francisco: Essential Until Deleted
OPEN-WHISTLEBLOWER.setup: DOGE calls missing staff “savings.” You know what those people did. You leave San Francisco with five companions and your case for D.C. The van has fewer departments, but you’re keeping the brakes.
OPEN-WHISTLEBLOWER.outcome: You set out. Nobody suggests improving fuel efficiency by removing the driver.

ORDER-DEREGULATE.title: Peace, Now With More War
ORDER-DEREGULATE.activation: The government promotes “Department of War” branding. The spokesperson calls it peace through strength. Your van would settle for peace through a working alternator.
ORDER-DEREGULATE.expiration: The reorganization event ends. The van has retained its original, less threatening name.

ORDER-GAG.title: A Very Dangerous Index
ORDER-GAG.activation: Book-panic bulletin: officials copy Trump’s ban on classroom “indoctrination.” The approved reading list arrives pre-approved, with instructions on how freely to discuss it.
ORDER-GAG.expiration: The panic recedes. A librarian quietly moves the books back where people can accidentally learn things.

ORDER-MILITARIZE.title: Freedom of Movement, Subject to Movement
ORDER-MILITARIZE.activation: Checkpoint bulletin: officials invoke Trump’s border-security rhetoric to add another road inspection. The officer asks why free citizens are always trying to go somewhere.
ORDER-MILITARIZE.expiration: The extra inspections end. Your destination is once again a place rather than an explanation.

ORDER-SHUTDOWN.title: Essential, Unpaid
ORDER-SHUTDOWN.activation: Shutdown bulletin: Congress has run out of agreement. Federal workers are asked to keep being essential on an optional-salary basis.
ORDER-SHUTDOWN.expiration: The shutdown ends. Paychecks may resume pretending this was a scheduling problem.

ORDER-TARIFFS.title: Foreign Aid, Domestic Wallet
ORDER-TARIFFS.activation: Trump’s tariff message says foreign countries will pay. Your grocery bill has volunteered to be a foreign country.
ORDER-TARIFFS.expiration: The tariff event ends. Your wallet would like its citizenship restored.

ORDER-TAXCUTS.title: Education Has Left the Building
ORDER-TAXCUTS.activation: The education department is eliminated. Officials promise to preserve learning. The exit sign has been assigned the remaining teaching hours.
ORDER-TAXCUTS.expiration: The order ends. The exit sign returns to its specialist subject.

REPAIR-ALTERNATOR.title: China Is Running Late
REPAIR-ALTERNATOR.setup: The alternator fails. The replacement costs more after Trump’s tariffs. The mechanic on the radio asks who’s paying. You say China. He asks for a shorter joke.

outcomes.not_completed: The repair is not complete. The van remains broken.
outcomes.cashless: Radio contacts can arrange work in exchange for a used part and repair. No cash or spare is needed.

c0.label: Fit the onboard spare
c0.outcome: You fit the onboard spare. China is excused from this particular invoice.

c1.label: Buy and fit a replacement
c1.outcome: The shop fits the replacement. Your money crosses the counter with remarkable international confidence.
c1.roadside_outcome: The replacement arrives and is fitted. The driver asks for you by name, which settles who is paying.

c2.label: Barter supplies for repairs
c2.outcome: You barter supplies for a used alternator and fit it. The food accepts responsibility for the tariff.

c3.label: Radio for work and repairs
c3.outcome: You do the arranged work for a used alternator and repair. China’s shift looks exactly like your crew.

REPAIR-BATTERY.title: Five Accomplishments, Zero Volts
REPAIR-BATTERY.setup: The battery dies. Inspired by DOGE, a crewmate asks it to list five accomplishments. It has powered every departure. Management asks what it did today.

outcomes.not_completed: The repair is not complete. The van remains broken.
outcomes.cashless: Radio contacts can arrange work in exchange for a used part and repair. No cash or spare is needed.

c0.label: Fit the onboard spare
c0.outcome: The spare battery is fitted. Its first accomplishment is making the dashboard stop being a mirror.

c1.label: Buy and fit a replacement
c1.outcome: The shop fits a replacement. You approve electricity without hiring a billionaire to investigate it.
c1.roadside_outcome: The replacement is delivered and fitted. The driver has accomplished something visible before sending an email.

c2.label: Barter supplies for repairs
c2.outcome: You barter supplies for a used battery and fit it. Experience survives another efficiency initiative.

c3.label: Radio for work and repairs
c3.outcome: You finish the arranged work and fit a used battery. The four-hour productivity review includes actual productivity.

REPAIR-FUELPUMP.title: Drill, Baby, Nothing
REPAIR-FUELPUMP.setup: The fuel pump fails. Trump’s “Drill, baby, drill” plays on the radio. Finding more oil is an unusually loud answer to the wrong broken part.

outcomes.not_completed: The repair is not complete. The van remains broken.
outcomes.cashless: Radio contacts can arrange work in exchange for a used part and repair. No cash or spare is needed.

c0.label: Fit the onboard spare
c0.outcome: You fit the spare pump. Fuel reaches the engine without finding a new oilfield.

c1.label: Buy and fit a replacement
c1.outcome: The shop fits a replacement. Distribution briefly gets more attention than drilling.
c1.roadside_outcome: The replacement arrives and is fitted. The driver repairs the route between the fuel you have and the engine that needs it.

c2.label: Barter supplies for repairs
c2.outcome: You barter supplies for a used pump and fit it. The tank’s existing reserves finally reach the public.

c3.label: Radio for work and repairs
c3.outcome: You complete the arranged work and fit a used pump. Your arms solve a problem the drilling speech could not reach.

REPAIR-TIRE.title: Trickle-Down Tread
REPAIR-TIRE.setup: A tire bursts beside a billionaire-funded tax-cut billboard. You find the tread beneath “prosperity.” So that’s the part that trickles down.

outcomes.not_completed: The repair is not complete. The van remains broken.
outcomes.cashless: Radio contacts can arrange work in exchange for a used part and repair. No cash or spare is needed.

c0.label: Fit the onboard spare
c0.outcome: You fit the spare. Wealth has not redistributed itself, but weight has.

c1.label: Buy and fit a replacement
c1.outcome: The shop fits the replacement. The billionaire’s billboard remains strangely unwilling to co-sign.
c1.roadside_outcome: The replacement arrives and is fitted. The delivery driver brings rubber; trickle-down economics sent nothing.

c2.label: Barter supplies for repairs
c2.outcome: You barter supplies for a used tire and fit it. An exchange with two actual beneficiaries feels suspiciously radical.

c3.label: Radio for work and repairs
c3.outcome: You finish the agreed work and fit a used tire. The self-made van required other people again.
